subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 5: Culture – Food around the world
outcomes: Describe special dishes from other countries.
Say what is in a dish and when we eat it.
Make a poster about a special food from Oman.

tf.s: Bubble tea has jelly balls in it.
tf.why: Yes! Bubble tea has jelly balls.

tf.s: The fish in sushi is cooked.
tf.why: The fish in sushi is raw. It isn't cooked.

tf.s: You need a plate to eat bunny chow.
tf.why: You eat bunny chow with a spoon and you don't need a plate.
Great! Shuwa is meat with spices.

tf.s: In Oman we eat shuwa at Eid.
tf.why: Correct! We eat shuwa at Eid.

tf.s: 'When do you eat it?' asks about the ingredients.
tf.why: 'What's in it?' asks about the ingredients.

tf.s: Bubble tea is a hot curry.
tf.why: Bubble tea is a drink with jelly balls.

tf.s: Harees has wheat and chicken in it.
tf.why: Well done! Harees has wheat and chicken.

tf.s: 'I really want to try sushi!' means you don't like sushi.
tf.why: It means you want to eat sushi very much.

tf.s: Bunny chow has curry in it.

boxes.why: In fondue, you dip food in warm chocolate.

boxes.q: Which question asks for the name of a food?
boxes.why: 'What's it called?' asks for the name.

boxes.q: Complete: I really want to ___ bubble tea!
boxes.why: We say 'I really want to try ...'.
'A lot of' tells us how much.

boxes.q: Which dish is rice with fish or vegetables?
boxes.why: Sushi is rice with fish or vegetables.

boxes.q: Complete: This is shuwa. ___ meat with spices.
boxes.why: One dish, so we say 'It is'.
Shuwa is a special food from Oman.

hunt.q: Fondue: you dip food in warm...
Bubble tea: you drink it with a...
Bunny chow: you eat it with a...
There's a lot ___ rice in it.

mcq.q: Which question asks about the time we eat a food?
What do people eat at Eid in Oman?
mcq.why: Shuwa is a special food for Eid.

mcq.q: Ali wants a dish that you dip food in. Which dish is it?
mcq.why: In fondue you dip food in warm chocolate.

mcq.q: Complete the poster: This is harees. It is wheat with ___ .

o: There's a lot of rice in it.
There's a lot of rices in it.
There are a lot of rice in it.
There's a lot rice in it.
mcq.why: We say 'There's a lot of rice in it'.

mcq.q: Sushi and bubble tea: how are they different?
o: You eat sushi with chopsticks and drink bubble tea with a straw.
You eat both with a spoon.
Both have warm chocolate in them.
mcq.why: Sushi uses chopsticks, and bubble tea uses a straw.

mcq.q: Sara doesn't like raw fish. Which dish is NOT good for her?
mcq.why: Sushi can have raw fish in it.

o: It has a picture, a title and clear sentences.
It has no title and no picture.
It has a picture but no sentences.
mcq.why: Pictures, a title and clear sentences make a great poster.
